fields.name: grasp_point
fields.description: The [y, x] of the peg end the demonstration gripper closed on. Set at the first decision step from the demonstration frame where the gripper is at its lowest (height about 0.01-0.03) and the fingers first drop from 100% open to the closed-on-peg width (about 22-25% open): take the peg head or peg tail entry nearest the gripper position in that frame, and record that end's coordinates as they appear in the start-of-execution scene (the pegs lie at the same positions as at demonstration t=0). Never changes afterwards, even once a peg is held. Whether that end is a head or a tail is not stored; it is whichever class ('peg head' or 'peg tail') lists those coordinates in the scene. e.g. [114, 212]

fields.name: insert_side
fields.description: The side of the box the demonstration inserted the peg from, right or left. Set at the first decision step from the final demonstration frames (gripper low, height about 0.04, fingers still closed, gripper y near the aperture box y): if the gripper x there is SMALLER than the aperture box x the value is right; if LARGER it is left. Never changes afterwards. e.g. right
